note: NECO Commerce Paper III round 1: the SSCE syllabus - meaning and scope, production and industry, home/foreign/entrepot trade, trade documents (invoice, credit note, quotation, statement), retailing and wholesaling, business units, banking services, insurance principles, transport documents (bill of lading, consignment note), warehousing (bonded stores), advertising and tourism. Near-dup scanned against the JAMB, WAEC and existing NECO banks.
